text:
- Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant; losses may top $86M. Broad crypto, self-custody sentiment. Risk-off. Fairly sure.
- ESMA gave EU firms three months to exit non-MiCA stablecoins; Tether’s buffer halved to $4.1B. USDT weaker, possible USDC bid. Headline sure, price less so.
- Ether ETFs outflowed nine days; traders fade a breakout near $2,500. SOL funds ended a 14-week inflow run. ETH and SOL softer. Moderately sure.
- NEAR rose on a quantum upgrade, ETF inflows and $33B intents volume, despite a hacker story. NEAR bid, choppy. Medium confidence.
- Bitcoin’s rebound faces an $80,400 test after ~$730M ETF outflows. Reserve-bill and insurer news are only a mild offset. BTC capped. Medium.
- Watch today: EU stablecoin-unwind headlines hitting USDT liquidity and spilling into BTC perps.
